_about: Inputs to the two-source air-date rule (scripts/tuf/lib/airDates.mjs), read by scripts/tuf/build_episodes.mjs. A season appears here only when an independent source for its broadcast dates has been captured. The network listing date itself comes from scripts/tuf/evidence/paramount_plus.json; the display date recorded here is the listing's separate human-readable date, kept as evidence. Never infer a season's dates from another season's agreement.
rule: air_date is resolved only when the network listing date exists and an independent source gives the same calendar date; otherwise null with the reason.

network.display_note: airdate is rendered as the next calendar day because airdate_iso is 19:00 Pacific (e.g. 2005-01-17T19:00:00-08:00 displays as Jan 18, 2005)

independent.cites: IMDb episode list (tt0445912), as cited by the article

source_defects.detail: The listing's titles for episodes 11 (Middleweight Semi-Final #2) and 12 (Light Heavyweight Semi-Finals) agree with every other source, but its two descriptions are swapped: item 11 describes the light heavyweight semi-finals and item 12 the last middleweight final spot. Titles are used; those descriptions are used only for pairings, never for placing a fact in an episode.
The display date is one day after the listing date for every item (19:00 Pacific rendered as the next UTC day). The listing date is the one compared.
